log.text: Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Rotom

decisions.rationale: Aerodactyl+Incineroar lead covers every opener: Fake Out+Intimidate blunts sand or Lopunny pressure, Tailwind lets my side outspeed Sand Rush Excadrill, Wide Guard blocks Rock Slide/EQ/Dazzling Gleam/Make It Rain. Metagross stays healthy in back as the Floette answer (mega Speed 178 outspeeds max-144 Floette, Iron Head threatens OHKO); Rotom-Wash is the catch-all for Excadrill/Rotom-Heat/Gholdengo.
decisions.notebook: Opponent game-1 bring: sand core (Tyranitar/Excadrill) + Rotom-Heat + Gholdengo; benched Floette-Eternal and Lopunny — expect one or both in game 2/3, possibly leading Lopunny+Floette for Fake Out + Moonblast/Calm Mind pressure. Tendencies: Rotom-Heat clicks Overheat into Metagross even vs Protect (reliably baitable — pivot Wash in, don't sack Metagross); Gholdengo plays greedy (Nasty Plot while behind); loses track of immunities under pressure (WoW into Fire-type Incineroar). Confirmed answers: Rotom-Wash (Levitate) walls Excadrill and Rotom-Heat, Hydro Pump OHKOing both; Incineroar+Wash both resist Make It Rain and Incineroar is burn-immune — that pair stonewalls Gholdengo/Rotom-Heat; use Flare Blitz, not Darkest Lariat, vs Colbur Gholdengo. My Mega Metagross hits 178 Speed, outspeeding max-144 Floette — keep it healthy as the Floette answer (Iron Head). Aerodactyl (200 Spe) outspeeds Lopunny (max 172) for Taunt from turn 2 even after eating Fake Out (Focus Sash). Game-2 plan: Aerodactyl+Incineroar lead, Metagross+Wash back; Tailwind neutralizes Sand Rush, Wide Guard covers spread spam.

decisions.rationale: Sand core leads: Tyranitar sets sand turn 1 so Sand Rush Excadrill (216) outspeeds Aerodactyl (max 200) and Mega Metagross, and LO Iron Head is a guaranteed OHKO on Aerodactyl (110-216%) to deny Tailwind/Wide Guard. Tyranitar Low Kick answers Incineroar; Crunch dodges Wide Guard. Backs: Gholdengo (Good as Gold blanks Taunt/Wisp, Ghost blanks Fake Out, Steel resists Rock/Ice, Make It Rain 2x on Aerodactyl/Mamoswine) and Lopunny (Fake Out sash-break, Encore lock, Helping Hand). Skip Floette/Rotom-
decisions.notebook:
MATCHUP FACTS (verified lvl50, Champions):
- Incineroar is Fire/Dark: CANNOT be burned. Its Flare Blitz OHKOs Gholdengo; Darkest Lariat halved by Colbur (~39-57%). Tyranitar Low Kick (80BP, 2x) is our Incineroar answer.
- Excadrill LO Iron Head OHKOs Aerodactyl (110-216%) but Focus Sash survives one hit; break Sash with Lopunny Fake Out or follow up. Aerodactyl is ROCK = immune to sand chip (earlier note claiming sand chips it is WRONG). Sand does chip Incineroar/Rotom/Manectric.
- Sand Rush Excadrill 216 Spe > Aerodactyl (max 200) and Mega Metagross (max 178), but loses to Tailwind-boosted foes; kill Aerodactyl before Tailwind.
- Mega Metagross Tough Claws Iron Head vs Tyranitar: base est 54-89%, x1.3 claws = ~70-116%, can OHKO. Don't assume Tyranitar survives.
- Excadrill EQ hits ally Tyranitar 2x; Wide Guard blocks Rock Slide/EQ, so Iron Head/Crunch are the safe clicks vs Aerodactyl leads.
- Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump OHKOs LO Excadrill, 2x on Tyranitar; Leftovers Rotom-Wash is their best long-game piece - remove early with Gholdengo Shadow Ball (37-70%, 73-137% at +2).
- Manectric: Lightning Rod + Shuca; never Thunderbolt near it. Its Overheat hits Excadrill 2x.
- Rotom-Heat Overheat OHKOs Mega Metagross but self -2 SpA and dies to Rock Slide/Taunt.
OPPONENT TENDENCIES: leads Mega Metagross + Aerodactyl; Metagross Megas and Protects T1 while Aerodactyl Taunts. Backs include Incineroar, Mamoswine, Rotom-Wash, Manectric. Encore can soft-lock a Protecting Metagross.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Incineroar)
decisions.rationale: Wide Guard blanks the likely double Rock Slide / Earthquake spam turn (both foes are -1 Atk and their spread moves are their best options), preserving Aerodactyl's Focus Sash. Flare Blitz is a guaranteed OHKO on Excadrill across its full legal range (100.9-194.6%), removing the Sand Rush threat immediately. If Excadrill Protects instead, Tyranitar's spread is still blocked and I can Tailwind next turn.

Under Tailwind, Mega Metagross (356) outspeeds Sand Rush Excadrill, but Rotom-Wash (212) and Incineroar (160) do NOT — Wide Guard is the spread-spam answer vs sand leads. Game-2 plan: Aerodactyl+Incineroar lead, Metagross+Wash back; Wide Guard turn 1 into sand, Tailwind turn 2.

decisions.rationale: Rotom-Wash is the safest, highest-value replacement: it quad-resists MakeItRain, walls Rotom-Heat, Levitate dodges any stray Earthquake, Leftovers cancels sand chip, and Hydro Pump pressures -1 Tyranitar (2x SE). Metagross stays healthy in back as the dedicated Floette-Eternal answer (Iron Head) and avoids exposure to Overheat/Shadow Ball from their likely backline.

decisions.rationale: Excadrill (216 in sand) Iron Heads Aerodactyl first: 68-163% guarantees Focus Sash breaks to 1 HP, and Wide Guard can't block a single-target move. Tyranitar Crunch then finishes Aerodactyl (24-60% is lethal at 1 HP), denying future Tailwind/Wide Guard/Taunt and removing their fastest mon. Fake Out may flinch one of ours, but Incineroar spending its turn on Fake Out means Excadrill dodges a guaranteed-OHKO Flare Blitz this turn. Rock Slide avoided due to Wide Guard risk.
decisions.notebook:
MATCHUP FACTS (verified lvl50, Champions):
- Incineroar Flare Blitz OHKOs our Excadrill (124-220%) AND Gholdengo. Excadrill outspeeds Incineroar in sand; must Protect/switch or KO it. Tyranitar Low Kick (80BP, 2x) is our Incineroar answer; Incineroar can't be burned. Darkest Lariat halved by Colbur on Gholdengo (~39-57%).
- Intimidate lowers our Atk on entry: Excadrill LO Iron Head vs Aerodactyl at -1 Atk = 68-163% (breaks Focus Sash to 1 HP, not guaranteed OHKO). Tyranitar -1 Crunch vs Aerodactyl 25-60%.
- Aerodactyl is Rock = immune to sand chip; sand chips Incineroar/Rotom/Manectric/Metagross? (Steel not immune-only Rock/Ground/Steel are: Steel IS immune). Rotom/Incineroar/Manectric take chip.
- Wide Guard blocks Rock Slide/EQ; Iron Head/Crunch are safe clicks vs Aerodactyl. Aerodactyl has no Protect.
- Sand Rush Excadrill 216 Spe beats Aerodactyl (max 200) and Mega Metagross (max 178) but loses under Tailwind: killing Aerodactyl/denying Tailwind is priority one.
- Mega Metagross Tough Claws Iron Head can OHKO Tyranitar (~70-116%).
- Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump OHKOs Excadrill, 2x on Tyranitar; remove with Gholdengo Shadow Ball (37-70%, 73-137% at +2).
- Manectric: Lightning Rod + Shuca; never click Electric near it; its Overheat is 2x on Excadrill.
OPPONENT TENDENCIES: leads Mega Metagross+Aerodactyl or Aerodactyl+Incineroar; Fake Out T1 plus Tailwind/Taunt. Encore can soft-lock a Protecting foe.
PLAN: trade early to erase Aerodactyl, keep sand up with Tyranitar alive, use Lopunny Fake Out/Encore to blank Incineroar or Metagross, then sweep with Sand Rush Excadrill.

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo would be OHKO'd by Incineroar's Flare Blitz on entry, so it can't come in now. Lopunny enters safely-ish and, since Incineroar's Fake Out is dead (it's been in play), Lopunny's own Fake Out is guaranteed to go first next turn, buying a free turn for Tyranitar to Low Kick weakened Incineroar or to blank the incoming Mega Metagross. Keeps Gholdengo healthy as our late-game breaker behind sand.
decisions.notebook:

- Incineroar Flare Blitz OHKOs Excadrill and Gholdengo; 33-112% vs Lopunny. Never switch Gholdengo in beside a healthy Incineroar. Incineroar can't be burned; Darkest Lariat halved by Colbur on Gholdengo (~39-57%).
- Tyranitar Low Kick (Incineroar 83kg = 80BP, 2x) is our Incineroar answer. Tyranitar Crunch is resisted by Incineroar.
- Fake Out only works the turn a Pokemon switches in: once Incineroar has been out a turn its Fake Out is dead, so Lopunny (146 Spe) gets free Fake Out turns vs anything including Mega Metagross (priority beats its 143-178 Spe).
- Mega Metagross Tough Claws Iron Head can OHKO Tyranitar (~70-116%); Gholdengo Shadow Ball is SE on it.
- Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump is 2x on Tyranitar; remove with Gholdengo Shadow Ball (37-70%; 73-137% at +2). Manectric: Lightning Rod+Shuca, never click Electric; Mamoswine EQ is 2x on Gholdengo, Thick Fat.
- Sand: Rock/Ground/Steel immune to chip; Incineroar, Rotom, Manectric, Mamoswine? (Ice/Ground = immune via Ground) take chip only if not those types.
- Wide Guard blocks Rock Slide/EQ; single-target moves safe.
OPPONENT TENDENCIES: leads Aerodactyl+Incineroar or Mega Metagross+Aerodactyl; T1 Fake Out/Wide Guard/Tailwind.
PLAN: Lopunny Fake Out/Encore to generate free turns, Tyranitar keeps sand and Low Kicks Fire/Steel targets, save Gholdengo (Nasty Plot) as closer vs Metagross/Rotom. In game 3, consider leading Lopunny+Tyranitar to Fake Out Aerodactyl and deny Tailwind before committing Excadrill.

decisions.rationale: Double-threat so Lopunny's Fake Out can only stop half: Hydro Pump into Tyranitar (67-118%, possible OHKO even with sand SpD boost) and Flare Blitz into Lopunny (52-99%, strips Sitrus, puts it in KO range for Wash/Metagross next turn). Incineroar survives -1 Rock Slide (~31-53%) and most -1 Low Kick rolls, with Sitrus as cushion. Protecting Incineroar wastes the turn if Wash eats Fake Out. Metagross stays healthy in back as the Floette answer.

decisions.rationale: Lopunny is faster than Rotom-Wash and its own first turn out, so Fake Out flinches the fresh Rotom and denies Hydro Pump, which can OHKO Tyranitar (67-120%). Meanwhile Tyranitar's Low Kick is our best hit on Incineroar (~26-56% into 62%), pushing it into Sitrus/sand range so we can finish next turn. Incineroar cannot Fake Out anymore, so worst case is a Flare Blitz into Lopunny (Sitrus) plus recoil, which favors us.
decisions.notebook:
MATCHUP FACTS (lvl50, Champions):
- Fake Out legality is USER-based: only on the user's first turn after entering. Flinch lands on any foe that hasn't moved yet. Incineroar's Fake Out is dead once it has been active a turn; our Lopunny (146 Spe) gets a flinch the turn it switches in, beating even Mega Metagross.
- Tyranitar Low Kick vs Incineroar (83kg, 80BP, 2x) = ~26-56% at -1 Atk; NOT a clean KO from 62%. Crunch is resisted. Helping Hand + Low Kick ~39-85%.
- Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump 67-120% on Tyranitar: treat as possible OHKO, always answer with flinch/Protect or pivot.
- Gholdengo resists both Hydro Pump and Thunderbolt (0.5x) and blocks Will-O-Wisp via Good as Gold: he is the hard Rotom/Manectric wall, but Incineroar Flare Blitz OHKOs him, so only bring him in once Incineroar is gone/weak.
- Mega Metagross Tough Claws Iron Head can OHKO Tyranitar; Gholdengo Shadow Ball is SE on it (37-70%, 73-137% at +2).
- Manectric: Lightning Rod + Shuca, never click Electric/Ground-weak reads. Mamoswine: Thick Fat, EQ 2x on Gholdengo.
- Sand chips Rotom (offset by Leftovers), Incineroar, Manectric; Rock/Ground/Steel immune.
- Wide Guard (Aerodactyl only) blocks Rock Slide.
OPPONENT TENDENCIES: leads Aerodactyl+Incineroar; T1 Wide Guard/Tailwind/Fake Out; brings Rotom in as revenge pivot.
PLAN: Lopunny generates flinch/Encore tempo; Tyranitar Low Kicks Fire/Steel/Dark; Gholdengo (Nasty Plot) closes vs Rotom/Metagross/Manectric. Game 3: lead Lopunny+Tyranitar to Fake Out Aerodactyl and deny Tailwind before committing Excadrill.

decisions.rationale: Tyranitar (Spe 81-113) always outspeeds Incineroar (80), and -1 Low Kick or Rock Slide KOs it at 25%, so attacking with Incineroar just loses it before it moves — Protect keeps it alive for Fake Out/Flare Blitz pressure and the Rotom-Heat/Gholdengo endgame. Lopunny's Fake Out now fails (not its first turn out); Encore locking Wash into Hydro Pump is acceptable. Hydro Pump is a coin-flip OHKO on Ttar (67-118%); killing Ttar removes sand and their main answer to Wash+Metagross.

Tendencies: doubles into Aerodactyl turn 1 (anti-lead priority); Rotom-Heat clicks Overheat into Metagross even vs Protect (pivot Wash, don't sack Gross); Gholdengo greedy Nasty Plot while behind; loses track of immunities (WoW into Incineroar). Incineroar Flare Blitz guaranteed OHKO on Excadrill. Mega Metagross 178 Spe outspeeds max-144 Floette — keep healthy as Floette answer (Iron Head); avoid Rotom-Heat/Gholdengo and Ttar Low Kick (120 BP vs 550kg, 2x). Aerodactyl (200) outspeeds Lopunny (max 172) for Taunt through Fake Out via Sash. Under Tailwind, Mega Metagross (356) outspeeds Sand Rush Excadrill; Wash (212) and Incineroar (160) do NOT — Wide Guard is the spread answer vs sand leads. Calc'd: Wash Hydro Pump vs Ttar in sand 67-118% (coin-flip OHKO, 80% acc); Incineroar Flare Blitz vs Lopunny 52-99% of max HP (KOs once Lopunny ~52%); Ttar min Spe 81 > Incineroar 80 — Incineroar never outspeeds Ttar, and -1 Low Kick/Rock Slide still KOs weakened Incineroar, so Protect to preserve it. Fake Out fails after user's first turn on field.

decisions.rationale: Rock Slide is a guaranteed KO on Incineroar from 24% (26.7-58.8%) even after spread reduction, and unlike Low Kick it still lands 15-34% chip on Rotom-Wash if Incineroar Protects. Aerodactyl (the only Wide Guard) is gone, so the spread is safe. Lopunny at 53% would fall to Flare Blitz and can't damage anything, so Protect preserves it (and dodges Hydro Pump) to re-enter later for a fresh Fake Out on Mega Metagross.

decisions.rationale: Rotom outspeeds Tyranitar and any Hydro Pump kills it at 40%, so attacking likely never happens. Fresh Protect (100%) guarantees Tyranitar survives. Lopunny is faster than both foes, so Encore lands before Incineroar acts and locks it into Protect (already at reduced success) for 3 turns: it cannot Flare Blitz Lopunny or my incoming Gholdengo, and sandstorm chip (18%) can finish it outright. This buys a safe Gholdengo entry next turn while conceding no damage.

- CORRECTION: Water and Electric are NEUTRAL on Gholdengo (Steel/Ghost). Rotom Hydro Pump 29-80% on Gholdengo; Gholdengo is NOT a Rotom wall. Good as Gold still blocks Will-O-Wisp/Snarl-status.
- Make It Rain vs Rotom-Wash is 0.25x (Water+Electric); use Shadow Ball vs Rotom. Make It Rain is for Mamoswine (Ice 2x), Manectric-ish, Metagross resists.
- Incineroar Flare Blitz 65-175% on Gholdengo: never expose Gholdengo while a healthy Incineroar can act.
- Encore CAN lock Protect; combined with the consecutive-Protect success penalty and sandstorm chip it neutralizes weakened Incineroar. Encore fails if target switched (switches resolve before moves).
- Fake Out only usable the turn a Pokemon switches in; Lopunny can pivot out and back to refresh it. Lopunny (146 Spe) outspeeds Rotom/Incineroar/Mega Metagross for Fake Out.
- Tyranitar at -1: Low Kick vs Incineroar ~32-40%; Rock Slide spread vs Incineroar 27-59%, vs Rotom 15-34%. Crunch resisted by Incineroar. Tyranitar (81 Spe) is slower than Rotom/Metagross, so flinch plays don't apply.

- Wide Guard only on Aerodactyl.

No-Mega keeps Metagross below Lopunny speed so Encore vs it fails, avoiding an Iron Head lock into a possible Steel-resist 4th. If Ttar chains Protect (1/3), we repeat with board advantage.
